errors.text_span: starting at approximately 31% and ending around 44%
errors.evidence: The 'Base' model line starts at approximately 28% and ends at approximately 32%. The stated values of 31% and 44% are significantly incorrect.
The line for the FT model is blue, not cyan.
The 'FT' model line ends at approximately 38%, not 41%.
The line for the MEMIT model is purple, not magenta.
The 'MEMIT' model is represented by pentagon markers. The square markers represent the 'ROME' model.
The 'IKE' model is represented by upward-pointing triangular markers, not hexagonal markers.
The 'IKE' model line starts at approximately 32%, not 38%.
The description completely omits the 'ROME' model (green line with square markers), which is the highest-performing model shown in the plot.
